title: Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan Premium Continuity and the Security Deposit Account Coverage
content:
**Term.** A lapse in guarantee premiums on a Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan Security Deposit Account scales the guarantee coverage by a premium-continuity share. The share depends on how many full months before the move-out date the last guarantee premium was paid:

- **0** when it was paid 24 or more full months before the move-out date;
- **0.50** when it was paid at least 12 but fewer than 24 full months before it;
- **1** (the coverage in full) when it was paid fewer than 12 full months before it.

The share multiplies the coverage as measured on the coverage rent: the coverage multiple, as it stands, times the coverage rent, times this share. The coverage is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Records read.** The date of the last guarantee premium recorded on the deposit account, and the move-out date.

## Ladder

| Full months from the last premium to move-out | Premium-continuity share |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 0 |
| 12 to 23 | 0.50 |
| 11 or fewer | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, move-out 15 September 2025)

| Last premium paid | Full months before move-out | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 15 September 2023 | 24 | 0 |
| 16 September 2023 | 23 | 0.50 |
| 15 September 2024 | 12 | 0.50 |
| 16 September 2024 | 11 | 1 |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A coverage multiple of 1.50 times a coverage rent of 2000.00 USD is 3000.00 USD. With a share of 0.50 it becomes 1500.00 USD, and with a share of 0 it becomes 0.00 USD.
